title: Delete dead code found by the repo survey (DropDown, common/utils Utils and RunListUtils, unused exceptions, lights package, DiffuseShader/LightShader, unused GLSL, Camera3D.orbit, ShaderProgram.drawTexture, ...)
description:
Repo plan phase 0. Candidates with no callers in main or test per grep (reconfirm each with a build before deleting; keep anything that turns out to be used and say so on the ticket):
- gui/ui/menu/DropDown (a near-copy of MenuBox, zero references).
- common/utils/Utils except printArray (fold printArray next to its callers in geometry/cuts); common/utils/RunListUtils; common/exceptions FileParseException and ShorterPathNotFoundException; platform/file/SolutionsResourceSupplier.
- platform/automation/AutomationEndpoint readBodyJson, writeError and both writeJson overloads; AutomationRuntime.meshSkeleton and parseDistanceType.
- graphics/render/lights/*, DiffuseShader (only an unused Canvas3D field), LightShader, glsl shader.vs/fs, light_shader.vs/fs, sdf_bezier_simple.fs.
- Camera3D.orbit (unused; OrbitMouseTrap owns orbiting), ShaderProgram.drawTexture (~200 lines, no callers).
- Check FontShader / ShaderType.Font: it looks vestigial (Font draws through SDFTexture) but is ShaderCodePane's fallback; delete only if nothing needs it.
- Ixdar/HANDOFF.md, which asks to be deleted once absorbed (it is superseded by REFACTOR-PLAN-2.md).
MapNodeContext is NOT dead (tests use it); leave it. The Python client's uncalled methods belong to the bug-batch ticket, not this one.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. Each listed item is deleted or kept with a reason on the ticket.
2. Build, unit suite and the TeaVM build (or the reason it cannot run) pass.
3. Every scene in CanvasSceneMap launches; ShaderCodePane still opens on a scene's shader.
4. Launch entry and screenshot.
testing-plan:
1. grep each symbol in main and test before deleting.
2. mvn test.
3. Live: main menu, a mesh scene, a 2D SDF demo scene, the shader code pane.
changes-made: Deleted (grep over main, test, resources, annotations, CLI and tools found no reference, including string/resource names): gui/ui/menu/DropDown; common/utils/Utils and RunListUtils; common/exceptions FileParseException and ShorterPathNotFoundException; platform/file/SolutionsResourceSupplier (a TeaVM ResourceSupplier with no META-INF/services registration, so never loaded); graphics/render/lights (DirectionalLight, PointLight, SpotLight, package-info); DiffuseShader and its unused Canvas3D field; LightShader; glsl shader.vs/fs, light_shader.vs/fs, sdf_bezier_simple.fs; Camera3D.orbit; AutomationEndpoint readBodyJson, writeError, both writeJson overloads and HTTP_OK (AutomationApiServer has its own private copies); AutomationRuntime.meshSkeleton, parseDistanceType and the ERROR constant only they used; Ixdar/HANDOFF.md.
Utils.printArray: its only caller, CutMatch.toString, now uses Arrays.toString (same null handling, TeaVM-safe); a commented-out call in CutMatchList.addCutMatch was removed with it.

ShaderProgram: removed drawTexture plus the unused drawTextureRegion overloads (texture 8-arg and 9-arg, float 9-arg) and drawBlankTextureRegion; kept the texture+corners overload SDFTexture/SDFUnion call and the float core it delegates to.

FontShader deleted with ShaderType.Font and font.fs: its only consumer was ShaderCodePane's null fallback, and all seven initCodePane callers (the anatomy SDF scenes) pass a non-null shader. ShaderCodePane now resolves shader, then provider. font.vs stays (FONT_VS is the vertex shader of every SDF ShaderType).
Kept: MapNodeContext (tests use it, per the ticket); nothing else on the list turned out to be used. Package docs for cameras and utils updated; ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated by the compile.
Verified: mvn -q compile clean; mvn test 518 run, 0 failures; tools/teavm-build.sh OK (classes.js 7.27 MB, 0 errors).

Live: all 21 CanvasSceneMap ids (19 annotated scenes plus ixdar and ixdar-canvas) launch headless and reach sceneReady; every screenshot is non-blank except model-load-canvas, which fails only because IXDAR_ASSET_REPO_ROOT is not set on this machine (unrelated to this change). The shader code pane opens on bezier-curve-canvas and the other anatomy SDF scenes (tmp/eng-18.png). Launch entry 'ENG-18: bezier-curve-canvas'.
